simple.summary: שָׁמָע (Shâmâʻ) means Shama , an Israelite First listed occurrence: 1Chr 11 44.

definitions.full: H8091. Shama שָׁמָע proper name, masculine a hero of David 1Chr 11:44 , Σαμαθα , Σαμμα (compare Osem. שמע on scarab ClGann JAS 1883 Fev.- Mars, 135, No. 9 ; also on seal from Megiddo (1904), compare Kau Mitth. u. Nachr. DPV, 1904, 2 f f. ).
